payload.title: Which hyp commit makes hyp print the /goal prompt for any Goal and read a run's constraints from the Goal body?
payload.body: Candidate: a commit in this repository. Rival Hypotheses are the commits a run builds; the lines of the Goal are owed on each.

why: top-level question of a build Goal; the run adds the rival commits

payload.summary: Grill of #113 done: Goal G-ZPCT72 (build Goal, 9 lines) written by owner-standin, top-level question Q-4B6RXM open for the run's rival commits. Run 6 clause-for-clause is not a line (no baseline); the baseline Goal and the root-store move are for the owner to add. The installed hyp has no prompt command, so the first /goal prompt is hand-written.
